title: Typography overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Use a consistent type voice so different messages still sound like the same organization.
strategic_value: Verizon NHG can give brand communication a recognizable, direct typographic character.
demonstration: The September 17, 2019 screenshot introduces Verizon NHG and pairs a black-on-white type specimen with white type over a photograph.
practical_value: Compare the same typeface on a plain field and imagery before choosing the treatment for a message.
